title: Data set article Exploring Rapport Management
descriptions: The study describes rapport management that takes place during physical face-to-face group work interactions and examines the complex negotiation of social categories during intercultural group work interactions. This ethnographically informed qualitative study involved participants who were first-year undergraduates. The findings confirm that rapport orientation is a key influence in strategy choice driven by the constructed social categories of the participants.
